title: Token get / refresh response (provisional)
x-verification: PROVISIONAL, secondary only (npm tiktok-shop-client, packagist haistar/tiktokshop-api-client, useresponse docs). Not in the OAS; docv2 token page unreadable. The official FAQ confirms the path /api/v2/token/get and an 'open_id' field only. access_token_expire_in is reported as a Unix-style timestamp, NOT a TTL: unconfirmed. Token endpoints may not share the OpenAPI envelope.
